name: push-guard
description: Pre-push code safety review skill and hook for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Block git push until a structured safety review is present
interface.longDescription: Push Guard provides a pre-push review skill and lifecycle hook that checks modified code across exception paths, encoding boundaries, external data validation, state invariants, secrets, semantic correctness, and test quality before git push.
defaultPrompt: Run a pre-push safety review for this repository
